title: Modification of Use and Bulk Regulations for Zoning Lots Fronting on Former West 208th Street
previewText: Where the lot line of a zoning lot coincides with the former boundary of West 208th Street, as shown on Map 1 in the Appendix to this Chapter, such lot line shall be considered a street line for the purpose of applying all use and bulk regulations of this Resolution.
